best_for: New streamers on Windows or Mac who want alerts, overlays and widgets built into the broadcasting app, and who will weigh the Ultra subscription once they want to multistream.
description:
Streamlabs Desktop is live streaming software from Streamlabs. It is made for streamers, gamers and other creators who want to capture, dress up and broadcast their streams from one app.

Automations read your gameplay as it happens and trigger visuals, scene switches, clips and replays, so you can keep your hands on the game. Alerts can fire for new followers, subscribers, tips, cheers and charity donations, and widgets add tip trackers, polls, games and follower goals. Cloudbot, a free chatbot, keeps trolls out and runs your own commands. Replay turns your best moments into highlight videos for YouTube, TikTok and Reels. Support is available around the clock through Discord or email.

points.title: Free covers the basics
points.text: You can stream to Twitch, YouTube, Kick, TikTok, X, Facebook or any custom RTMP server, build scenes, record and show alerts for free. Dual Output sends a horizontal and a vertical layout at once, also free. Local recordings have no watermark or time limit.

points.title: Ultra is the paid line
points.text: Multistreaming to several platforms, the full theme and overlay library, Collab Cam with up to 11 guests, 10 GB of cloud storage and the full app store need Ultra. The Ultra page lists it from USD 15.75 per month, while the plan table shows USD 27 monthly or USD 179 yearly, so check the checkout price. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Account only for the extras
points.text: Recording works without a Streamlabs account. Alerts, widgets, cloud backup and platform links need you to sign in.

points.title: Built on OBS, heavier than OBS
points.text: It is open source under GPL-3.0 and built on OBS and Electron. The download is about 500 MB, the minimum is 8 GB of RAM, and 16 GB or more is recommended.

points.title: Mac needs macOS 12
points.text: The minimum is Windows 10 or macOS 12, with macOS 13 or later recommended. Macs get separate Intel and Apple Silicon downloads. There is no Linux version.

points.title: Windows keeps more versions
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 26 versions of the 64-bit, all-users installer. macOS lists only the current release, and at review time it was 1.21.6 against 1.22.5 on Windows.
